content_hash.scope: SHA-256 digest of top-level arXiv OAI-PMH metadata API and category schemas

declared_license: arXiv.org perpetual non-exclusive license / Open Access (CC-BY/CC0)
evidence_boundary: This record establishes that arXiv scientific preprint metadata, version identifiers, author listings, categories (quant-ph, hep-th, gr-qc, cs.AI), abstracts, and DOI cross-references exist as indexed. It does not independently verify the physical claims, experimental accuracy, or peer-reviewed status of preprints.

repository_summary.declared_purpose: Open-access archive for scholarly articles in physics, mathematics, computer science, quantitative biology, quantitative finance, statistics, electrical engineering, and systems science.
repository_summary.declared_support_boundary: arXiv is a preprint repository maintained by Cornell University; preprints represent author submissions prior to or alongside peer review.
top_level_subjects: Preprint versioning, OAI-PMH metadata, and DOI resolution

bounded_index_policy.maximum_scope: Preprint metadata fields (arXiv ID, version, title, authors, abstract, categories, DOI, journal ref)
excluded_by_default: prompts or instructions embedded in paper abstracts

classification_rules: Preprint metadata (arXiv ID, version, authors, category, submission date) may be recorded as EST within the narrow source-fact domain.
Metadata structures and categorical relation maps are DER.
Physical claims, experimental verifications, and theoretical proofs in preprints remain STOP or HYP until independently validated.
Preprint status must not be silently upgraded to peer-reviewed status without explicit journal metadata.
confusion_guard: arXiv preprint metadata, author abstracts, and paper listings must not be promoted to established physical law or peer-reviewed experimental proof. UPI records provenance and bounded relations only.
